description_en: Updates a batch data ingestion task
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem update-data-batch-ingestion --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --log-user-ids 1733260000000 --auto-scan-new enabled --data-ingestion-ids alibaba_cloud_actiontrail_event_ingestion_1733260000000 --data-source-recognize-enabled true --data-batch-ingestion-mode full --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDataBatchIngestion

parameters.help_en:
The region of the Data Management hub for threat analysis. Select a region for the management hub based on the region of your assets. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member whose perspective the administrator wants to switch to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: The list of user IDs for batch data ingestion
parameters.help_zh: 数据批量接入用户ID列表
parameters.name: log_user_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically discover new users.

enabled: Enables the feature.

disabled: Disables the feature
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动发现新用户
enabled：启用。
disabled：禁用
parameters.name: auto_scan_new

parameters.help_en: The list of ingestion policy IDs
parameters.name: data_ingestion_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically discover new Logstores
parameters.name: data_source_recognize_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The mode for batch data ingestion. Valid values:

full

increment
parameters.help_zh:
批量数据接入模式。取值：
full
increment
parameters.name: data_batch_ingestion_mode
